name: VaultSparkStudios.github.io
currentFocus: S301 finished the Obelisk identity lane. The three Supabase credentials S300 escalated are now in the gateway and all four authority planes probe ready, so the two runtime blockers became agent work under CANON-019/CANON-040 and identity receipt blockers went 3 to 1 — the survivor is the founder-gated real-provider-e2e. The behavioural probe found more than the audit predicted: public.get_classified_files() was RAISING SQLSTATE 42702 for every authenticated caller, so the classified archive returned nothing to anyone, and its committed repair had sat unapplied for nine days. Applied with a pre-image captured first; the eternal-intelligence edge function was proven drifted by byte-searching the deployed bundle and redeployed v3 to v4. Root fix: the identity evidence file was hand-authored and fed a public receipt, so two blockers were clearable by editing prose — two live verifiers are now its only supported writers and write only what they re-read from the provider after the write. Capability discovery was itself generating phantom blockers (an UNKNOWN capability name rendered as a MISSING credential); UNKNOWN and MISSING are now distinct states with distinct exit codes.
publicNote: Members on the top tier could not open the classified archive — in fact nobody signed in could, because the page behind it was erroring for everyone. That is fixed and checked against the live site, not just the code. We also closed a gap where our own records could say a fix was live without anything having verified it; now only an automatic check can make that claim.
nextMilestone: Founder: one real Obelisk sign-in at vaultsparkstudios.com/login closes real-provider-e2e, the last identity blocker; and decide the confirm_content dispatch that ends the production staleness. Agent-side, the login scan cliff (every callback pages every user; breaks at 2,000 accounts) is designed and instrumented but escalated, because it touches the authentication flow.
blockers: real-provider-e2e-pending: one real Obelisk login is still required. Everything automatable is verified — per-request PKCE/state/nonce proven to differ across independent observations, forged callback rejected with zero set-cookie, ambient identity anonymous-null. No agent path exists and inventing one would be fabricated evidence.
Production remains behind main pending the founder confirm_content dispatch. Measured, alarmed, and BLOCKING in the doctor rather than silently green.

Login scan cliff is FOUNDER-GATED, not unresolved: scanSupabaseUsers pages every user per callback and throws at 2,000 accounts. Fails closed, so a capacity limit at ~8x current scale (1,748 accounts of headroom). The fix touches the authentication flow, which AGENTS.md puts behind escalation.
publicNextStep: Next, one real sign-in test finishes the proof on the new single sign-on, and then the finished improvements can go live.
